pm_exper_user_4775_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some ways to set up a compact drink station in my home office to make remote work more enjoyable?
pm_exper_user_4775_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You could dedicate a small corner of your desk to a compact tea station, stocked with an electric kettle, a variety of loose-leaf blends in glass jars, and a few favorite cups. Add a small tray for sweeteners and strainers, so you can enjoy a calming brew without leaving your work space.
(b) Consider setting up a narrow wall-mounted shelf with a pour-over setup, your preferred French press, and a good electric kettle. Keep a jar of freshly ground beans within easy reach, so you can brew a fragrant cup during breaks without interrupting your workflow.
(c) A rolling cart could hold a compact capsule coffee maker, a small grinder, and a neatly arranged tray with spoons, sugar, and your favorite ceramic mugs. This way, you can wheel your coffee ritual to wherever you feel most inspired in your office.
(d) You could dedicate a small corner of your desk to a sleek espresso machine and a selection of your favorite beans, perhaps stored in airtight glass jars for both freshness and aesthetics. Add a compact milk frother and a few elegant cups, so you can craft café-quality coffee without leaving your work space.
